# Data preparation

Join the supplied descriptive and state-program records by `person_id`.
The code saves only `dat` in `processed_data.rda` for
[Analysis.qmd](Analysis.qmd). The raw ICPSR files remain in `data/`.

```{r prepare-data}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(haven)
  library(dplyr)
})

dat <- local({
  descriptive <- read_dta("data/ICPSR_34314/DS0001/34314-0001-Data.dta")
  programs <- read_dta("data/ICPSR_34314/DS0002/34314-0002-Data.dta")
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(descriptive$person_id),
            !anyDuplicated(programs$person_id),
            setequal(descriptive$person_id, programs$person_id),
            all(is.na(descriptive$numhh_list)))

  out <- descriptive |>
    transmute(
      person_id = as.integer(person_id),
      household_id = as.integer(household_id),
      postn_death = as.integer(postn_death),
      treatment = as.integer(treatment),
      draw_lottery = factor(as.integer(draw_lottery)),
      have_phone_list = as.integer(have_phone_list),
      pobox_list = as.integer(pobox_list),
      self_list = as.integer(self_list),
      week_list = factor(as.integer(week_list))
    ) |>
    left_join(
      transmute(programs, person_id = as.integer(person_id),
                ohp_all_ever_matchn_30sep2009 = as.integer(ohp_all_ever_matchn_30sep2009)),
      by = "person_id"
    )
  stopifnot(nrow(out) == 74922L, !anyNA(out),
            all(out$postn_death %in% 0:1), all(out$ohp_all_ever_matchn_30sep2009 %in% 0:1), all(out$treatment %in% 0:1))
  out
})
save(dat, file = "processed_data.rda", compress = "xz")
head(dat, 5)
```

# Variables and availability

Missingness is measured across all 74,922 people before any analysis exclusions.
`numhh_list` is restricted and excluded from the saved model data. Household
identifiers remain available for clustering; counting retained people does not
recover the original lottery-list household size.

```{r variable-availability}
local({
  variables <- tibble(
    Variable = c(names(dat), "numhh_list"),
    Source = c(rep("DS0001", 9), "DS0002", "DS0001"),
    Role = c("Identifier", "Cluster identifier", "Outcome", "Instrument",
             rep("Covariate", 5), "Treatment", "Unavailable covariate"),
    Description = c("Person identifier", "Household identifier", "Death after notification",
      "Lottery selection", "Lottery/matched draw", "Phone number supplied at signup",
      "PO-box address at signup", "Self-registration", "Signup week",
      "Any Medicaid enrollment through September 2009", "Household members on lottery list"),
    Availability = c(rep("Available", ncol(dat)), "Restricted; excluded"),
    Missing_percent = c(vapply(dat, function(x) round(100 * mean(is.na(x)), 2), numeric(1)), 100)
  )
  knitr::kable(variables, row.names = FALSE)
})
```

The [ICPSR codebook](data/ICPSR_34314/34314-Codebook.pdf), PDF page 4,
confirms that `numhh_list` was recoded to missing. Mortality is available, but
its public-file window ends before January 2010; the paper ends follow-up in
September 2009.
